      3. Autism core domains

      Mark each domain first. Context and example will appear only when a domain is present currently or by history. Criterion A requires all 3 social domains; Criterion B requires at least 2 of 4 restricted / repetitive domains.
      A. Social communication and social interaction
      A1. Social-emotional reciprocityBack-and-forth interaction, sharing of interests/emotions, initiation or response.
      A2. Nonverbal social communicationEye contact, gesture, facial expression, body language and integration with speech.
      A3. Relationships and social understandingAdjusting behaviour, imaginative/social play, friendship and interest in peers.
      B. Restricted or repetitive behaviour, interests or activities
      B1. Repetitive movement, object use or speechStereotypies, lining up/flipping objects, echolalia or idiosyncratic phrases.
      B2. Sameness, routines or ritualised behaviourDistress with change, transitions, rigid thinking, routes, food or verbal rituals.
      B3. Restricted or fixated interestsInterests abnormal in intensity or focus, unusual attachments or perseveration.
      B4. Sensory reactivity or unusual sensory interestHyper/hyporeactivity, pain/temperature response, sounds, textures, smell or visual interest.

      Modified Centor Score

      Estimates the likelihood of group A streptococcal pharyngitis. This score supports testing decisions only and does not confirm the diagnosis or mandate antibiotics.
      Select applicable findings.
      Use the local sore-throat pathway, clinical assessment and testing availability. Avoid prescribing antibiotics solely from the score.

      eGFR — CKD-EPI 2021

      Adult calculator for age ≥18 years. Uses the race-free 2021 CKD-EPI creatinine equation: age, sex and standardized serum creatinine only. Weight and height are not required for eGFR.
      Enter age, sex and serum creatinine.
      G category alone does not diagnose CKD. Interpret together with chronicity, urine albumin and other markers of kidney damage. Use caution in acute kidney injury or situations where serum creatinine may be unreliable.
      Official CKD-EPI 2021 equation
      Optional: Cockcroft-Gault CrCl & body surface area

      These values are separate from CKD-EPI eGFR. Enter weight for Cockcroft-Gault; enter both weight and height for Mosteller BSA.

      PHQ-9 & GAD-7

      Score symptoms over the previous 2 weeks. Item 9 requires direct suicide-risk assessment regardless of total score.
      Select responses.

      Burch-Wartofsky Point Scale

      Supports assessment of suspected thyroid storm; do not delay emergency treatment or referral when clinically suspected.
      Select clinical findings.

      Pre-Eclampsia Prophylaxis Assessment

      Based on the MOH Handbook of Obstetrics Guideline 2024, Prevention of Pre-Eclampsia, handbook page 81. Pre-eclampsia is sometimes abbreviated as PET in obstetric notes and guidelines. Start aspirin and calcium carbonate when there is ≥1 major or ≥2 minor risk factors.
      Major risk factors
      Minor risk factors
      BMI ≥30 kg/m² is added automatically as a minor risk factor.
      Enter gestation, weight, BMI and applicable risk factors.
      Source: Handbook of Obstetrics Guideline, Medical Development Division, Ministry of Health Malaysia, published 2024, Prevention of Preeclampsia, handbook page 81 (PDF page 93).

      GDM Risk & When to Perform MGTT

      Based on the MOH Handbook of Obstetrics Guideline 2024 and the Malaysian CPG Management of Diabetes in Pregnancy 2017. At-risk women should have a 75-g mOGTT/MGTT at booking or as early as possible; if normal, repeat at 24–28 weeks. Universal screening at 24–28 weeks is recommended.
      GDM risk factors
      BMI >27 kg/m² is added automatically as a risk factor.
      Enter gestation, BMI, previous test status and applicable risk factors.
      Diagnostic reference for the Malaysian 75-g two-point OGTT: GDM if fasting plasma glucose ≥5.1 mmol/L or 2-hour plasma glucose ≥7.8 mmol/L. Overt diabetes thresholds require separate clinical confirmation and management.
